as_told.title: Lazar: Russians kicked out as ARV tensions rose

plain: In the 1980s, Russians are said to have been at Area 51, working with the Americans on a kind of joint space programme, until they were pushed out as tensions grew over the building of ARVs, short for alien reproduction vehicles, man-made craft modelled on alien ones. Michels gives this as a rumour that comes from Bob Lazar, a man who has said since 1989 that he worked on alien craft at a secret site in Nevada. If true, it would mean that the Cold War rivals once quietly shared the secret.
